summary: Adds shared strict snapshot/settings/command validation, legacy defaults and saved reminder CRUD with independent active messages.
Checks editor revisions, submits partial settings patches, preserves rejected drafts and serializes cooperating preview saves with Web Locks.
Persists accepted worker data before reconciling alarms/windows, reports post-save effect warnings and repairs missing effects on later reads.
Preserves corrupt preview data for raw export and requires a confirmed, baseline-checked reset; retains local artwork upload and timer behavior.
Adds 39 Node cases, ten Chromium scenarios including a real unpacked extension, four reviewed layouts, a verified matching extension archive and nine detailed CRUD learning lessons.

checks.command: npm run build; npm test; Playwright ten scenarios; one affected layout recheck; archive member equality

limits: Local preview/extension only; no HTTP data service, SQL database, authentication, remote sharing or durable distributed outbox.
Preview Web Locks and worker serialization coordinate participating local operations; direct storage writers and cross-device concurrency are outside the protocol.
Alarms can be delayed, including by sleep. Reconciliation is best effort; simultaneous cleanup and ID-persistence failure can leave an orphan window.
Raw export has no implemented general import. Preview and extension storage are separate. No personal profile, sleep/crash/power-loss durability or full accessibility certification was tested.
